title: SSC GD Constable 2026 CBT Last Phase May 25–30 - 25,487 Vacancies, Result Date Expected Soon
author: Ash K.
summary: SSC GD Constable 2026 Computer-Based Test (CBT) is in its final phase - May 25 to 30, 2026. 25,487 vacancies across BSF, CISF, CRPF, ITBP, SSB, Assam Rifles, SSF, and NCB. Exam running since April 27. Result and answer key expected within weeks. Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Physical Standard Test (PST) to follow for qualifying candidates.
body: The SSC GD Constable 2026 Computer-Based Test (CBT) is in its final phase from May 25 to 30, 2026. The exam, which started April 27, is being conducted across hundreds of centres throughout India for 25,487 vacancies in BSF, CISF, CRPF, ITBP, SSB, Assam Rifles (Rifleman GD), Secretariat Security Force (SSF), and the Narcotics Control Bureau (Sepoy).

DetailInformation
CBT Last PhaseMay 25–30, 2026
Total Vacancies25,487 posts
Forces CoveredBSF, CISF, CRPF, ITBP, SSB, Assam Rifles, SSF, NCB
Exam StartedApril 27, 2026
CBT Duration60 minutes | 80 questions | 160 marks
SubjectsGK/GS, Maths, Reasoning, English/Hindi
Negative Marking0.25 marks per wrong answer
EligibilityClass 10 pass | Age 18–23 years
Application Fee₹100 (women/SC/ST/Ex-SM exempted)
Provisional Answer KeyExpected within 2–3 weeks of CBT conclusion
CBT Result ExpectedJune–July 2026 (based on past cycles)
Next Stage After CBTPET/PST → Medical Exam → Document Verification

What to expect after the exam: Once the CBT phase concludes on May 30, SSC will release the provisional answer key on ssc.gov.in within 2–3 weeks. Candidates can challenge the answer key within the stipulated window. The CBT result is expected in June–July 2026. Shortlisted candidates will then appear for the Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Physical Standard Test (PST) - which tests running distance, height, chest (for male candidates), and weight.

PET requirements - Male candidates: Run 5 km in 24 minutes (for most candidates); candidates from Ladakh run 1 mile in 6.5 minutes. Female candidates: Run 1.6 km in 8.5 minutes (Ladakh: 800 metres in 4 minutes). Height requirement for male General/OBC/SC: 170 cm; ST: 162.5 cm. Female General/OBC/SC: 157 cm; ST: 150 cm. Ex-servicemen have different norms.

Forces with highest vacancies (2026): CISF has the largest share, followed by CRPF, BSF, SSB, and ITBP. The exact force-wise and state-wise breakdown was published in the SSC GD notification December 2025. Candidates should check the original notification for their state's vacancy count for each force.

Important note on the April 27 Kolkata cancellation: SSC cancelled the exam at three centres on April 27 - AMS Institute (Kolkata), Santiniketan Polytechnic (Durgapur), and Lala Lajpat Rai Memorial Polytechnic College, Moga (Punjab) - due to technical issues. Affected candidates were given fresh dates. Those candidates should check ssc.gov.in for their rescheduled slot. Check our SSC CHSL exam guide and SSC CPO guide for other SSC opportunities.

faqs.question: When does SSC GD Constable 2026 CBT end?
faqs.answer: The SSC GD Constable 2026 CBT final phase runs from May 25 to May 30, 2026. The exam started on April 27 and covers 25,487 vacancies across multiple central armed forces.

faqs.question: How many vacancies are there in SSC GD Constable 2026?
faqs.answer: SSC GD Constable 2026 has 25,487 vacancies across BSF, CISF, CRPF, ITBP, SSB, Assam Rifles (Rifleman GD), Secretariat Security Force (SSF), and NCB (Sepoy). CISF has the highest share of vacancies.

faqs.question: When will SSC GD 2026 result be declared?
faqs.answer: The SSC GD Constable 2026 CBT result is expected in June–July 2026, a few weeks after the exam concludes on May 30. Before the result, SSC will release a provisional answer key with a challenge window.

faqs.question: What is the SSC GD Constable 2026 exam pattern?
faqs.answer: The CBT has 80 questions worth 160 marks to be completed in 60 minutes. Subjects are General Knowledge/General Science, Mathematics, Reasoning, and English/Hindi. Negative marking is 0.25 marks per wrong answer.

faqs.question: What are the PET requirements for SSC GD Constable 2026?
faqs.answer: Male candidates must run 5 km in 24 minutes. Female candidates must run 1.6 km in 8.5 minutes. Height requirement for male General category is 170 cm and female General category is 157 cm. Reserved category candidates have relaxed physical standards.

faqs.question: What is the SSC GD Constable 2026 eligibility?
faqs.answer: Candidates must have passed Class 10 (Matriculation) from a recognised board. Age limit is 18 to 23 years (with relaxation for reserved categories). Indian nationality is mandatory.

callout.heading: Appeared in SSC GD CBT? Start PET Prep Now
callout.content: Don't wait for the result. If your CBT went well, start physical preparation immediately - PET requires running 5 km in 24 minutes (males) or 1.6 km in 8.5 minutes (females). Results typically come 4–6 weeks after the last exam date. Use this time to build stamina.
